findings.title: Five-row extrusion does not preserve the source interference field's longitudinal structure

defects.observation: The original's central traces and neighboring clusters wander laterally, change width and have local interruptions along their height. Every candidate bright strip instead has two straight vertical edges and uninterrupted fill between circle intersections. This is visible in the native raster and all normal-width previews.
defects.impact: The distribution illustrated for the learner no longer preserves these source visual facts. Cleaning isolated reproduction noise would be defensible; systematically deleting all longitudinal variation is a materially different operation.

defects.observation: A five-row majority sample supplies 41 bright x intervals, including 13 one-pixel intervals. For example source interval [178,179) becomes f217-bright-run-19: a connected polygon with opposite-boundary endpoints and vertical displacement assertions. Those inputs establish light near the central sample, not one continuous fringe at that x throughout the circle.
defects.impact: The construction promotes sampled bright fragments into clean full-height tracks and propagates local dark gaps over the whole field. The author explicitly does not claim 41 physical fringes, and neither does this review; the defect is unsupported longitudinal geometry, not a falsely attributed numerical count.

findings.whyExistingPassesDoNotClose: Source-profile agreement measures the same central slice used to construct the candidate. Containment, strip-width and vertical-edge checks cannot test the omitted longitudinal facts, and the author discloses rather than restores them. Passing them is not independent substantive approval.
findings.textContext: The complete current text asks for an interference pattern, not a calibrated count or shift diagram. Alternation alone is satisfied, but that limited success does not waive the source-image inventory contract for this source-bound instructional figure.
findings.closureRequirement: An explicitly authorized later figure task must preserve the observable longitudinal structure or obtain human approval for a different, honestly scoped authored illustration. Do not invent fringe counts, arbitrary optical topology, shift arrows or scales. No repair or further renderer call is authorized or performed by this review.
